map.二手车还要交购置税吗？: Do used cars still pay purchase tax?
map.已上牌的二手车在所有权转移时不再征收车辆购置税（原车主已缴），工具给出的「理论购: A used car already registered is not levied the vehicle purchase tax on ownership transfer (original owner paid); the tool's "theoretical purchase tax" is only the formula-based theoretical value and is clearly marked "exempt", not an actual charge. What actually occurs are transfer fee, registration fee, vehicle-and-vessel tax (annual), compulsory traffic insurance (annual) and possible agency fee.
